title: Chicago: home street

title: Rain arrives

title: Signature take Z: Miami → orbit
action: Start on the Miami home street used in shot 11. One continuous pull-back through neighbourhood, city, region, continent, globe and orbit. No cut, dissolve, planet swap or photographic texture. Shots 15–16 are annotations inside ONE take Z.
vo: From this street to the wider world.
evidence: Use approved street-to-space-v1 ladder, adapted geographically to Miami, never copy Denver landforms. Same WGS84 anchor, ellipsoid, world-space sun, cloud field and controlled time throughout. Strict flat land-cover colours, cotton clouds, soft atmosphere, terminator and diffuse warm night glows. Miami remains on day side; satellite orbit line retained, epoch/computation time displayed. Entire zoom must be real continuous engine capture.

title: Signature take Z: return + close
action: Continue take Z from orbit, smoothly reverse and descend through the SAME ladder to the exact home camera. Settle by 88s; hold 88–90s for plain-text WorldEngine and pending line. No edit at the 15/16 boundary.
evidence: One continuous forward-and-return camera take; no crossfade or reverse-playback shortcut. Route/village remain spatially anchored and persistent. Same mid-afternoon home lighting returns without time reset. Titles may be editorial; world and LOD transitions must render in engine.
